coreAttributes.name: 'KISS'
coreAttributes.description: A pepperball revolver, heavily modified by [#(flags.hasFlag('xys_ringmaker_quest_complete'))?'Ysette':'a certain ringmaker'] to shoot concentrated arcane bullets instead of pepperballs. Stamped on the body is an insignia of a heart surrounded by a chain, and the word [style.colourDmgLust("KISS")] in cursive is etched on the handle.
coreAttributes.equipText: [npc.Name] [npc.verb(take)] out the revolver and focus [npc.her] arcane energy into it. Pink bullets begin to form inside the chamber, before solidfying. [npc.She] [npc.verb(give)] it a once over before disengaging the safety.
coreAttributes.unequipText: [npc.Name] [npc.verb(swing)] out the cylinder and [npc.verb(gives)] it a shake, dissipating the remaining bullets into the air, before putting the revolver away.

hitDescriptions.hitText: [npc.Name] [npc.verb(line)] [npc2.name] up in [npc.her] sights and [npc.verb(pull)] the trigger. The round hits [npc2.her] [npc2.arm] and dissipates on impact, making [npc2.herHim] [npc2.moan] from the sudden increased arousal.

[npc.Name] [npc.verb(line)] [npc2.name] up in [npc.her] sights and [npc.verb(pull)] the trigger. The round hits [npc2.her] [npc2.leg] and dissipates on impact, making [npc2.herHim] [npc2.moan] from the sudden increased arousal.

[npc.Name] [npc.verb(line)] [npc2.name] up in [npc.her] sights and [npc.verb(pull)] the trigger. The round hits [npc2.her] [npc2.face] and dissipates on impact, making [npc2.herHim] [npc2.moan] from the sudden increased arousal.

missDescriptions.missText: [npc.Name] [npc.verb(line)] up [npc2.name] in [npc.her] sights and [npc.verb(pull)] the trigger at [npc2.name]. The hazy bullet misses [npc2.herHim] completely and dissipates uselessly in the distance.
